from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RetainedEarningsRecord(BaseModel):
    """A company's retained earnings value from one document's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    retained_earnings_end_balance: float | None = Field(description="The end balance of 未分配利润 as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元', '百万元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    retained_earnings_records: list[RetainedEarningsRecord]
